answer: Coordination-priced identity via pair escrow. Each identity registers by opening a small escrow with every counterparty it transacts with; the escrow unlocks only after both sides confirm the same coordination round. A sybil cluster's fake identities must escrow pairwise among themselves, so the attacker's cost grows with the square of cluster size rather than linearly. Honest agents treat this escrow as a haven for trust, while each fake identity becomes a costly pearl the attacker must keep funding. Any identity that abandons its escrow is flagged as a relic and blocked.
